name: DCA-A6-01 · AI Product Translation & Sync (prices and formatting stay intact)

parameters.content:
## 🌍 AI Product Translation & Sync
**Write once → translated everywhere → prices and formatting untouched.**

### Setup (about 15 minutes)
1. **⚙️ Config** → set `targetLanguages` and `protectedTerms`
   (your brand, product names — anything that must never be translated).
2. Set `aiEndpoint` / `aiModel`, add your API key as **Header Auth** on
   **🧠 Translate**.
3. POST your product to the Production URL:
   ```json
   { "productId": "book-01", "title": "...",
     "description": "...", "price": "$49" }
   ```
4. Wire **📤 Deliver translations** to your CMS / site / database.

### It only pays for what changed
Source text is hashed. Re-send the same product and unchanged fields are
**skipped entirely** — no API call, no cost, no gratuitous diff.

### 🔒 What must never be translated
Naive translation workflows break these three things:

**Prices** — `$49` becomes `٤٩ دولارًا` and your checkout breaks.
**Brand and product names** — helpfully rendered into Arabic and now
nobody can find them.
**Formatting** — markdown and HTML come back rearranged, so the page
renders wrong in exactly the languages you cannot read.

This replaces them with placeholders **before** translating and restores
them after, then verifies every placeholder came back.

### ↔️ RTL is handled, not assumed
Arabic · Hebrew · Farsi · Urdu need `dir="rtl"`.

A translation that is linguistically perfect and renders left-to-right
**looks broken** to the reader.

Direction is emitted with every translation so your site does not have to
remember which languages need it.

### ✅ Structure is verified after translation
Every translation is checked before it is delivered:

· all protected placeholders returned
· markdown/HTML tag counts match the source
· output is not suspiciously short or empty

A failed check **does not silently publish**. It is flagged and the
original is kept, because a broken translation on a live sales page is
worse than no translation.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: protectedTerms: your brand and product names. These are never translated.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Guard · validate + dedupe
nodes.notes: Validates required fields and drops duplicate deliveries. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: 🔒 Protect literals and check what changed
nodes.notes: Placeholders protect prices/brands/URLs. Hashing skips unchanged text so you only pay for real changes.

nodes.name: 🧠 Translate

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: $json.__config.aiModel,
  max_tokens: $json.__config.maxTokens,
  system: 'You translate e-commerce product copy from ' + $json.__config.sourceLanguage + ' to the requested language.

'
    + 'ABSOLUTE RULES:
'
    + '1. Any token shaped like «0», «1», «2» is a placeholder. Copy it EXACTLY and UNCHANGED into your output. '
    + 'Never translate it, never renumber it, never add or remove one. They hold prices, URLs and brand names.
'
    + '2. Preserve ALL formatting exactly: markdown, HTML tags, line breaks, bullet points.
'
    + '3. Translate meaning, not words. Marketing copy should read as if written natively.
'
    + '4. Tone: ' + $json.__config.tone + '

'
    + 'Reply with STRICT JSON only, no markdown fence:
'
    + '{"title": "<translated title>", "description": "<translated description>"}',
  messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Target language code: ' + $json.lang + '

TITLE:
' + $json.protectedTitle + '

DESCRIPTION:
' + $json.protectedDescription } ]
}) }}

nodes.notes: Add your API key as a Header Auth credential.

nodes.name: 🔓 Restore literals and verify
nodes.notes: Verifies placeholders and structure. A failed check keeps the source rather than publishing something broken.

nodes.name: 💾 Remember what was translated
nodes.notes: Only successful translations are cached, so failures retry next run.

nodes.name: ⏭️ Unchanged — reuse existing
nodes.notes: No API call. This is where the cost saving comes from.

nodes.name: 📤 Deliver translations
nodes.notes: Wire to your CMS. Anything unverified is reported, never silently published.

nodes.name: 🚨 Handle failure
nodes.notes: Structured failure record. Wire to your alert channel.

nodes.name: ↩️ 200 OK
nodes.notes: Answer fast so the provider does not retry on timeout.
